_doc: Black 2's new-game intro (pokebw2 res/text/system/game_start.txt; the lines ov294 src/ov294/intro_script.c shows) with Professor Rowan's speech from Pearl (pokediamond narc_0341: 0, 1 without its first-adventure/advice part, 16, 19-30; converted by b2tools/gen4_text.py b2_line). The rival's default name is Pearl's Barry (seen in game 2026-10-18: Pearl's scenes said 'Hugh'). Rowan's start-of-game questions (new lines, 2026-10-18; patches/pearl_intro.py QUESTIONS) on lines Black 2 leaves blank: 26 (Empty_8) the Fairy type, YES/NO = lines 19/20; 27 (Empty_9) the music, with the answers 28 (Empty_10) SINNOH and 30 (Empty_11) UNOVA; 36 (Empty_15) the Exp. Share and 37 (Empty_16) the seasons (2026-10-19), 38 (Empty_17) the following Pokémon (2026-10-26, asked before the seasons), YES/NO; 31, 34, 35 are still blank for the sprite question (later). The packed file must stay under Black 2's own 4,684 B (pearl_intro.measure_text). Applied by patches/sinnoh_names.py.

game_start.GameStart_Text_HiThereWelcomeWorld: Hello there!\nIt’s so very nice to meet you!{be01}\nWelcome to the world of Pokémon!{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_NameProfessorJuniperEvery: My name is Rowan.{be01}\nHowever, everyone just calls me\nthe Pokémon Professor.{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_ThatsRightWorldWidely: This world is widely inhabited by\ncreatures known as Pokémon.{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_WellThatsEnoughFrom: Now, why don’t you tell me\na little bit about yourself?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_BoyGirl: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_YoureBoyRight: All right, so you’re a boy?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_YoureGirlRight: All right, so you’re a girl?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_IdLikeKnowName: Tell me, what is your name?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_NamesWhatWonderfulName: OK...\nSo, you’re {0100:0}?{be01}\nA fine name that is!{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_CouldTellLittleAbout: Now, this boy here...\nI believe he’s your friend.{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_Empty_9: Would you hear the songs of Sinnoh,\nor of faraway Unova?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_Empty_15: The Exp. Share gives Exp. Points\nto your whole team.{be01}\nWill you set out with one?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_Empty_16: Last, would you see the seasons\nchange with the months?{be01}
game_start.GameStart_Text_Empty_17: Will your first Pokémon walk with\nyou wherever you go?{be01}
